title: WAMotor: Accelerating World Action Models via Speculative Inference under Dual Nonuniform Denoising Dynamics
title_zh: WAMotor：在双重非均匀去噪动态下通过推测推理加速世界动作模型
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) unify world modeling and action generation for robotic control by integrating flow-matching velocities, yet suffer from high multi-step denoising latency. Recent studies have explored speculative inference to accelerate WAMs by drafting and verifying denoising steps in parallel. However, existing methods either require training task-specific draft models or overlook critical WAM denoising dynamics when reusing past velocities as drafts. We revisit the denoising dynamics of WAMs and identify a dual nonuniformity that breaks standard velocity-reuse assumptions: velocity smoothness is nonuniform as adjacent velocity residuals differ sharply at early and final steps, so reuse there yields large residuals, which nonuniform integration time steps further translate into local state errors that accumulate into the final action distribution. Accordingly, we formalize this by theoretically deriving a trajectory error tolerance bound that characterizes how velocity residuals and integration time steps affect the final action distribution. Based on this, we propose WAMotor, the first speculative inference method tailored to the dual nonuniformity in WAMs. It selects reliable anchor velocities by deferring speculation and employs time-step-aware verification that scales acceptance thresholds by integration time step size. WAMotor offers plug-and-play benefits, enabling seamless integration with prior WAMs. Extensive evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and LIBERO-Plus show that WAMotor achieves 2.86$\times$--4.28$\times$ end-to-end speedups while maintaining task success rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Overdue-Lin/WAMotor
abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过整合流匹配速度来统一世界建模与动作生成，用于机器人控制，但面临多步去噪的高延迟问题。近期研究探索了推测推理，通过并行起草和验证去噪步骤来加速WAMs。然而，现有方法要么需要训练任务特定的草稿模型，要么在将过去的速度重用为草稿时忽略了关键的WAM去噪动态。我们重新审视了WAMs的去噪动态，并识别出一种双重非均匀性，它打破了标准的速度重用假设：速度平滑性是非均匀的，因为相邻速度残差在早期和最终步骤差异显著，因此在这些步骤重用会产生大残差，而非均匀的积分时间步进一步将其转化为局部状态误差，并累积到最终动作分布中。据此，我们通过理论推导出一个轨迹误差容忍界来形式化这一点，该界刻画了速度残差和积分时间步如何影响最终动作分布。基于此，我们提出了WAMotor，这是第一个针对WAMs中双重非均匀性量身定制的推测推理方法。它通过延迟推测来选择可靠锚点速度，并采用时间步感知的验证，根据积分时间步大小缩放接受阈值。WAMotor提供即插即用的优势，能够与先前的WAMs无缝集成。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-Plus上的广泛评估表明，WAMotor在保持任务成功率的同时，实现了2.86倍至4.28倍的端到端加速。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Overdue-Lin/WAMotor获取。
tldr_zh: WAMotor通过推测推理加速世界动作模型，实现2.86-4.28倍加速且保持成功率。
